fusions.name: Scalding Vent
fusions.desc: Vents a cone of scalding steam that deals 12 damage to everything within 3.5 tiles ahead of you and pushes each target back 2.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stinging Polyp
fusions.desc: A raking weapon strike edged with stinging growth that deals 8 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each use costs 3% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Touch and Burn
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it sets them [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Vent Bloom
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, you gain a shield worth 8% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
